messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — Tara just accepted a promotion to Senior PM and it's her 3-year Redwood anniversary today! :tada:
Tara: omg you all, I'm blushing 😭 thank you!! super excited and I couldn't have done it without this team.
Chloe: YASSSS congrats!!! cake? karaoke? both? :raised_hands:
Nate: cake + karaoke is a dangerous combo. I'm in. :cake: :microphone:
Jess: I'll order sushi if people want something lighter. poll: 1️⃣ cake 2️⃣ sushi 3️⃣ dim sum 4️⃣ bring your own instrument
Marco: Vote cast for cake. Also congrats Tara!! big win.
Lina: Amazing news. Tara's been killing it on the routing project — so deserved. :star2:
Raj: Double congrats. people-ops — can we do a small budget for team treats? :money_with_wings:
people-ops: Congrats Tara! We'll send a promo announcement + a mug. @Tara DM me your tee size and whether you prefer cake or sushi for tomorrow.
Aisha: ok poll results so far: 1️⃣ cake(3) 2️⃣ sushi(1) 3️⃣ dim sum(0) 4️⃣ instrument(0). Cake is winning.
Jess: gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/congrats-party-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZYWc
Tara: you guys are the best. Can we do a sushi-cake hybrid? jk jk. Will bring champagne.
Chloe: Champagne yes please 🥂
Nate: I'll handle the playlist for karaoke. Drop requests here.
Aisha: Love this. Quick note: let's keep the party small in conference room B at 4pm tomorrow. RSVP by EOD please.
